title: What If Earth Stopped Spinning for 1 Second? #Shorts
description:
If the Earth stopped spinning for just one second, the atmosphere would continue moving at one thousand miles per hour. A supersonic wall of wind would instantly obliterate cities, oceans would surge into towering mile-high tsunamis, and everything not anchored to bedrock would be violently launched eastward into the sky.
